text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This weather, the wind speed, the 
humidity, and even the track condition are 
all perfect...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Extrapolating from past mock races held 
under identical conditions on campus, as 
well as my current physical abilities...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We can do this...! We can do this, 
Trainer! We can expect a great result from 
this race!
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. Of course! In fact, I can hardly 
wait for you to see me run!”

—Biwa Hayahide seems to be completely 
motivated!
